create.title: Exact two-row incidence and target-safe fixed-wrap moving-coefficient collar
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), DE asymp M<=R^2, D<=sqrt(M), Q=2sqrt(ND/E), and retain the exact Round-149 compressed row. For d=eta m with m=d_o odd squarefree and L_i=t_i s_i^2, expanding a_i|t_i, c_i=t_i/a_i, u_i, and v_i gives the exact two-row mask 1_(F|m)1_((m,P)=1)=1_((F,P)=1) sum_(z|P)mu(z)1_(Fz|m), where F=lcm(a_1u_1,a_2u_2) and P=rad(c_1c_2s_1s_2v_1v_2); both exact prefixes and sampled profiles remain joint row-cell functions. The fixed-(L_1,L_2) incidence projective norm is X^epsilon, and uniformly in every finite prefix sum_L |B_(d,U)(L)|/sqrt(L)<<X^epsilon. For q_i=hr_i, (r_1,r_2)=1, delta=L_1r_2-L_2r_1, and centered rho=Ndelta-khr_1r_2, the complete coefficient-weighted absolute mass of 0<|rho|<=hr_1r_2/D in each fixed wrap class k is <<DQX^epsilon after all rows. Hence any O(1+R^2/Q)=O(1+sqrt(M)/D) wrap classes, including the complete k=0 collar and a symmetric small-wrap packet, cost <<R^2DX^epsilon. If M is bounded absolutely, the actual Round-148 sampled profile has bounded q-variation on its fixed-scale support and a weighted second-derivative estimate gives |G_U(d)|<<RX^epsilon, so the entire transformed bottom-scale row has energy <<R^2DX^epsilon. The growing-M large-wrap collar and growing-M generic complement remain open.

create.title: Growing-M large-wrap shifted-factor and profile-hypothesis obstruction
create.statement_tex: In the nonexact collar one has the exact identities (NL_1-khr_1)(NL_2+khr_2)=N^2L_1L_2+kh rho, r_2(NL_1-khr_1)=NL_2r_1+rho, and r_1(NL_2+khr_2)=NL_1r_2-rho. Both factors are positive on support, including q_i|N cases. For fixed (L_1,L_2,h,k,rho) with k nonzero, divisor recovery gives at most X^epsilon candidate pairs, but separately summing all legal h,k,rho has adverse raw capacity NL_1L_2QX^epsilon/D, larger than the trivial L_1L_2Q^2 pair capacity by N/(DQ) asymp R^2sqrt(M)/D^2>=R. The k=0 class has its separate determinant or fixed-wrap owner. This is a no-go only for per-shift absolute divisor summation and is not a signed lower bound. The target-safe fixed-wrap packet has size O(1+R^2/Q), whereas the full wrap range has size N/Q and is larger by order R^2. At D=1,L_1=L_2=1 the growing-M residual is an actual chi_4-weighted reciprocal sum with no row average. A statement-only countermodel also proves that boundedness and pointwise smoothness of an otherwise arbitrary profile cannot imply the full collar theorem; it does not refute the actual profile or the absolute fixed-wrap count. No audited existing shifted-divisor, large-sieve, or Kloosterman-fraction theorem directly matches the joint large-wrap coefficient. The obstruction is scoped to current proof placements, not an impossibility theorem for a joint signed estimate or further exact recombination.
